Rep. Jim Jordan, head of the House Judiciary Committee, claims Jack Smith provided false testimony regarding his team's access to the content of text messages from members of Congress.

The Bright Side:
Congressional oversight of special counsel activities is a necessary check on power, regardless of the political motivations involved.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This is a WHO vs HOW error. The focus is on the person (Smith) rather than the systemic issue of metadata privacy for legislators.

Social Physics Analysis:
This is a classic projection loop. By accusing the investigator of lying, the committee justifies its own aggressive pursuit, maintaining a state of conflict to satisfy a political base.

The Trajectory: The Path of Reckoning.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The cycle of retribution erodes institutional trust.

The Unavoidable Truth: Both sides are using legal processes as weapons of political warfare.

The Unavoidable Lie: This referral is purely about upholding the sanctity of congressional testimony.
